description_en: Downloads the parsing result of a data tracking task
description_zh: 下载数据追踪日志解析结果
kebab_example: aliyun dms-enterprise download-data-track-result --order-id 4060000 --rollback-sql-type REVERSE --filter-start-time 2023-04-23_00:00:00 --filter-end-time 2023-04-23_10:00:00 --filter-table-list table2 --filter-type-list UPDATE --column-filter '{"Operator":"EQUAL","ColumnName":"account_name","InList":["1"],"Value":"1","BetweenEnd":"10","BetweenStart":"1"}' --event-id-list 1 --tid 3000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DownloadDataTrackResult

parameters.help_en: The ID of the ticket. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/144643.html operation to obtain the ticket ID
parameters.help_zh: 工单ID，您可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/144643.html接口获取该参数的值
parameters.name: order_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the SQL statement.

*   **REVERSE**: undoes or rolls back an executed SQL statement, which is equivalent to the UNDO SQL statement.
*   **FORWARD**: redoes or re-executes an SQL statement that failed to be executed, which is equivalent to the REDO SQL statement
parameters.help_zh:
生成SQL类型：
- **REVERSE**：撤销（回滚）已执行的SQL，相当于UNDO SQL。
- **FORWARD**：重新执行（重做）之前未执行成功的SQL，相当于REDO SQL
parameters.name: rollback_sql_type

parameters.help_en: The start time of the time range in which you want to track data operations. The time must be specified in the yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss format
parameters.help_zh: 数据追踪的起始时间，格式为yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss
parameters.name: filter_start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the time range in which you want to track data operations. The time must be specified in the yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss format
parameters.help_zh: 数据追踪的结束时间，格式为yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss
parameters.name: filter_end_time

parameters.help_en: The names of the tables for which you want to track data operations
parameters.name: filter_table_list

parameters.help_en: The types of data operations that you want to track
parameters.name: filter_type_list

fields.help_en:
The type of the operator used to configure the filter condition. Valid values:

*   **EQUAL**: retrieves the column whose value is equal to the specified value.
*   **NOT_EQUAL**: retrieves the column whose value is not equal to the specified value.
*   **IN**: retrieves the column whose value is in the IN list.
*   **BETWEEN**: retrieves the column whose value is in the specified range.
*   **LESS**: retrieves the column whose value is less than the specified value.
*   **MORE**: retrieves the column whose value is greater than the specified value.
*   **NOT_IN**: retrieves the column whose value is not in the IN list
fields.help_zh:
操作类型，取值和说明如下：
- **EQUAL**：等于。
- **NOT_EQUAL**：不等于。
- **IN**：存在于IN列表中。
- **BETWEEN**：范围。
- **LESS**：小于。
- **MORE**：大于。
- **NOT_IN**：不存在于IN列表中
fields.name: operator

fields.help_en: The value used in the filter condition
fields.name: value

fields.help_en: The start value of the range used in the filter condition. This parameter takes effect only when Operator is set to BETWEEN
fields.help_zh: 操作类型为BETWEEN 时，需要指定追踪范围起始值
fields.name: between_start

fields.help_en: The end value of the range used in the filter condition. This parameter takes effect only when Operator is set to BETWEEN
fields.help_zh: 操作类型为BETWEEN 时，需要指定追踪范围的终止值
fields.name: between_end

fields.help_en: The IN list used in the filter condition
fields.name: in_list

parameters.help_en: The ID of the tenant. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198073.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198074.html operation to query the tenant ID
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID，可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198073.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198074.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: tid
